en.v: is made of real silk and is very comfortable to wear in summer.

examples.zh: 这条短裤是真丝做的，夏天穿起来很舒服。

errata.original: This pair of shorts is made of real silk and is very <u>comfortable</u> to wear in summer.
errata.corrected: This pair of <u>shorts</u> is made of real silk and is very comfortable to wear in summer.
errata.note: 例句下划线应标在词目 shorts 上，原书误标在 comfortable 上；经人工复核（GitHub #137 第 83 条）确认更正
